method: Chromium render on Newsprint; ink = channel distance from Newsprint over 45; near black = every channel under 70; red = R over 170, G and B under 120; crisp = an ink pixel within a channel distance of 40 of Charcoal, Stone or Pillar Red

l6.units: L6's 1400 by 300 units; 884 px wide is 0.6314 px per unit
